ProofData.statement: Let $X$ be a pseudometric space. Definition: given a natural number $a$, a real number $q$, a kernel $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, functions $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and sets $F, G \subseteq X$, the type of structures $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ on $X$; according to the docstring, it bundles the data common throughout most of Chapters 2–7 (except Chapter 3).

ProofData.toKernelProofData.statement: Let $X$ be a pseudometric space, $a$ a natural number, $q$ a real number, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$ and $F, G \subseteq X$. Definition: the kernel data $\mathrm{KernelProofData}(a, K)$ underlying a structure $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$.

defaultS.statement: Let $X$ be a pseudometric space equipped with $\mathrm{ProofData}(a, q, K, \sigma_1, \sigma_2, F, G)$ (with $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, $F, G \subseteq X$). Definition: the natural number $S = \mathrm{defaultS}(X)$ associated with this data.
